wizard.title: Guided connection
wizard.bt_windows: 1. Plug the ELM327 into the vehicle and switch the ignition on. 2. Open Windows Bluetooth settings and pair the adapter. Common PINs for simple ELM327 SPP adapters are 1234 or 0000. 3. Refresh the COM-port list afterwards. If Windows creates several Bluetooth COM ports, the outgoing serial port is normally the correct one.
wizard.bt_linux: 1. Plug the ELM327 into the vehicle and switch the ignition on. 2. Pair it using the system Bluetooth settings or bluetoothctl. 3. Find paired devices below, select the ELM327 and create the RFCOMM port. Channel 1 is common for simple ELM327 SPP adapters.
wizard.adapter_intro: Select an ELM327 or compatible adapter. For Bluetooth, a serial COM/RFCOMM port must exist first.
wizard.auto_hint: Auto detect tries standard OBD protocols and known manufacturer-specific profiles in sequence. Each attempt is shown on the next page.
